item.title: Kacmarynski Dominates as P.C. Wins Regional Opener
item.description: Rachel Kacmarynski scored 21 points and grabbed 19 rebounds in just over three quarters of action as the Pella Christian girls basketball team routed Chariton 46-26 in the opening round of the Class 3A playoffs Saturday night

item.title: Indianola Sends 13 Wrestlers to State Tournament with District Victory
item.description: The Indianola boys wrestling team is sending 13 wrestlers to the state tournament with a district tournament victory in Fort Dodge Saturday. The Indians won the tournament by 40.5 points with a toal score of 233 points.
